meta.name: add-codex
meta.description: Use Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as a full agent provider — planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume — alongside or instead of Claude. ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key, vault-only via OneCLI. Per-group via `ncl groups config update --provider codex`. Distinct from using OpenAI as an MCP tool (where Claude remains the planner).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 Codex 设为主智能体,接替 Claude 做规划、调用工具并恢复历史会话。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望终端 AI 的规划与工具调度由 Codex 接管。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Codex to lead planning and tool calls in your terminal instead of Claude.

howto.what: 装上后,可把 Codex 设为某个群组的 agent 后端,由它负责规划、工具调度、MCP 工具、服务端会话历史和会话恢复;凭据只存 OneCLI 保险库,不写进 .env。
howto.when: 当你在主机上把某个群组切换为 codex 并重启时接管;新群组默认仍用 claude,需另行选择才改默认。

say.text: 把 123 群组换成 codex 后端
把新建群组的默认后端改成 codex

howto.what_en: Installs Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as a group's full agent provider: planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history and session resume, alongside or instead of Claude. Credentials are vault-only via OneCLI.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you switch a group on the host with `ncl groups config update --provider codex` and restart it. New groups still default to claude until you opt in.

say_en.text: Switch group 123 to the codex provider
say_en.note: Runs ncl groups config update --provider codex, then restarts the group.
Runs the vault auth walk-through: ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key.
Sets DEFAULT_AGENT_PROVIDER=codex and restarts the host.
